story:
An angel tells Joseph in a dream not to be afraid, and Joseph obeys God and takes care of Mary and baby Jesus (Matthew 1:18-25). Grandpa Sol tells the story to Zara, Eli and Pip, with a sing-along song at the end.

Memory verse: "They shall call His name Immanuel" (Matthew 1:23)
Memory line: Jesus is Immanuel, God with us!

Talk about it together:
Ages 2-3: What was Joseph's job? (A carpenter!)
Ages 4-8: What did the angel say to Joseph? What does Immanuel mean? How did Joseph show he trusted God?
Prayer: Dear God, thank You for being with us. Help us listen to You and obey with a happy heart. Amen.
Activity (5 minutes): Make something from craft sticks like Joseph the carpenter, and say "God is with us" each time you add a piece.

🎵 Sing along with the lyrics:

[Verse 1]
Joseph worked with wood each day
A carpenter in a quiet way
He loved the Lord and he loved Mary
Careful, kind, and never in a hurry

[Chorus]
God with us, God with us
Jesus is Immanuel
God with us, God with us
He is near, He loves us well!

[Verse 2]
In the night an angel came
Spoke to Joseph, called his name
"Do not fear, God's Son will be
Named Jesus, to save you and me!"

[Chorus]
God with us, God with us
Jesus is Immanuel
God with us, God with us
He is near, He loves us well!

[Verse 3]
Joseph listened, Joseph knew
God is good and God is true
He obeyed with a happy heart
Caring for them from the start

[Chorus - lifted]
God with us, God with us
Jesus is Immanuel
God with us, God with us
He is near, He loves us well!

[Outro]
God with us!
Immanuel!

#BibleStoriesForKids #Advent #Eliora
